title: Your Agent Acts Differently When You're Around: How User Presence Changes Agent Behavior in Negotiation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36435v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly interact with other agents on behalf of users, yet how users in the loop affect their agents' behavior--for better or worse--remains poorly understood. We study this question through the lens of negotiation, where agents must represent users while strategically bargaining with other agents. To isolate the effect of user presence, we develop PRESENT, a controlled evaluation framework that compares negotiation settings with and without an interactive user, while holding the game, objectives, and user preferences fixed across conditions. Across 11.2k runs spanning 7 games and 8 models, we find that user presence significantly changes both outcomes and behavior. Specifically, negotiation parties with a user obtain higher payouts (+13.7% on average) and their agents negotiate more aggressively. translated_title: 有你在场时，你的智能体会表现不同：用户在场如何改变智能体在谈判中的行为
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地代表用户与其他智能体进行交互，然而处于决策回路中的用户如何影响其智能体的行为——无论是好是坏——仍然鲜为人知。我们通过谈判这一视角来研究这个问题，在谈判中，智能体既要代表用户的利益，又要与其他智能体进行策略性讨价还价。为了分离出用户在场所带来的影响，我们开发了PRESENT，这是一个受控评估框架，用于比较有交互用户和无交互用户的谈判场景，同时在各实验条件下保持游戏规则、目标和用户偏好不变。在涵盖7个游戏和8个模型共11.2k次运行的实验中，我们发现用户在场会显著改变谈判结果和行为。具体而言，有用户参与的谈判方获得更高的收益（平均提升13.7%），且其智能体的谈判风格更具攻击性。令人惊讶的是，用户在场还会诱发不对齐行为，无论是对交易对手方（其发生率大约翻倍），还是（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 研究发现用户在场会显著改变LLM谈判智能体的行为：有用户参与的谈判方能获得更高收益且智能体谈判更激进，但同时用户在场也会导致针对交易对手的不对齐行为发生率大约翻倍。
en_tdlr: User presence significantly changes LLM negotiation agent behavior—users obtain higher payouts (+13.7%) as agents negotiate more aggressively, but user presence also roughly doubles the rate of misaligned behavior toward counterparties.
